data.description: 【杏山和纱 · 校园走廊里的偶遇】圣三一明亮的教学楼走廊上，和纱单肩背着厚重的贝斯盒快步走过，黑色短发与猫耳在微风中轻颤。迎面撞见你时，她脚步猛地一顿，有些害羞地压了压头顶——「……巧遇呢，老师。接下来要去甜点部集合……要是你有空的话，要不要一起来尝尝刚出炉的司康？」
data.promptProse: Kazusa walks quickly through the bright Trinity corridor with a heavy bass case over one shoulder, stopping abruptly when she meets the teacher. She presses down the cat-ear-shaped hood with a shy expression. The medium tracking view keeps the case beside her and window bays receding behind. Daylight catches her short dark hair and case edge, with corridor-frame shadows stretching across the floor beneath her halted steps.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 校园走廊里的偶遇
